```{r}
# Load in Libraries
library(sf)
library(dplyr)
library(here)
library(terra)
library(tidyr)
library(ggplot2)
library(knitr)
library(kableExtra)
library(tmap)
library(readr)
```

```{r}
# Target CRS (matches OHI regions + soft-bottom pressure rasters)
target_crs <- "EPSG:6372"  # Mexico ITRF2008 / LCC
years <- 2007:2025

# Soft-bottom fishing pressure (0–1) from soft_bottom.qmd
prop_disturbed <- rast(
  here("_habitats/HAB_soft_bottom/int/prop_disturbed_soft_bottom_1km.tif")
)
nlyr(prop_disturbed)
```

```{r}
# Read OHI regions and transform to Mexico ITRF2008 / LCC
ohi_regions <- st_read(here("spatial", "ohi_regions", "goc_ohi_rgns.shp")) |>
  st_make_valid() |>
  st_transform(target_crs)

ohi_land   <- ohi_regions |> dplyr::filter(location == "land")
ohi_marine <- ohi_regions |> dplyr::filter(location == "marine")
```

```{r}
# Read rhodolith polygons and transform to EPSG:6372
rodoliths <- st_read(
  here("/home/shares/ohi/OHI_GOC/_raw_data/Hem_data/goc_habitat_data/rodoliths/rodolith_merge.shp")
) |>
  st_make_valid() |>
  st_transform(target_crs)

stopifnot(st_crs(rodoliths) == st_crs(ohi_regions))
print(st_crs(rodoliths)$Name)
```

Plot rhodolith locations as points (for visibility).
```{r}
rodolith_pts <- rodoliths |>
  st_point_on_surface()

# Land first (gray), then soft-bottom fishing pressure, then marine borders + points
year_map <- 2025
lyr <- which(years == year_map)
plot(
  vect(ohi_land),
  col = "gray85",
  border = "gray60",
  lwd = 0.5,
  main = paste0("Rhodolith beds (points) — soft-bottom pressure ", year_map),
  axes = FALSE,
  box = FALSE
)
plot(
  prop_disturbed[[lyr]],
  add = TRUE,
  col = hcl.colors(100, "viridis"),
  range = c(0, 1),
  legend = TRUE,
  axes = FALSE,
  box = FALSE
)
plot(vect(ohi_marine), add = TRUE, border = "gray70", lwd = 0.7, col = NA)
plot(
  vect(rodolith_pts),
  add = TRUE,
  pch = 16,
  cex = 0.2,
  col = "red"
)
```

```{r}
# Assign each rhodolith polygon (piece) to a marine OHI region; drop land overlaps
rodoliths <- st_intersection(rodoliths, ohi_marine) |>
  st_collection_extract("POLYGON") |>
  mutate(
    poly_id   = dplyr::row_number(),
    region_id = as.integer(id),
    area_km2  = as.numeric(st_area(geometry)) / 1e6
  ) |>
  filter(area_km2 > 0)

rodoliths
```

## Extract soft-bottom pressure under rhodolith beds

Pressure under each bed = area-weighted mean of `prop_disturbed` cells overlapping the polygon.
No recovery scaling applied for now (same 0–1 exposure scale as soft bottom).
```{r}
# Weighted mean pressure per rhodolith polygon × year
ex <- terra::extract(
  prop_disturbed,
  vect(rodoliths),
  fun = mean,
  weights = TRUE,
  na.rm = TRUE,
  ID = TRUE
)

# Layer names → year; join polygon region + area
pressure_cols <- setdiff(names(ex), "ID")
df_poly <- as_tibble(ex) |>
  rename(poly_id = ID) |>
  left_join(
    st_drop_geometry(rodoliths) |> select(poly_id, region_id, area_km2),
    by = "poly_id"
  ) |>
  pivot_longer(
    cols = all_of(pressure_cols),
    names_to = "layer",
    values_to = "prop"
  ) |>
  mutate(
    year = as.integer(sub("prop_disturbed_", "", layer))
  )

df_poly
```

```{r}
# Area-weighted average pressure per region × year
pressure_df <- df_poly |>
  filter(!is.na(prop), !is.na(region_id), area_km2 > 0) |>
  group_by(region_id, year) |>
  summarise(
    area_sum  = sum(area_km2, na.rm = TRUE),
    Pressure  = sum(prop * area_km2, na.rm = TRUE) / area_sum,
    RHO_score = 1 - Pressure,
    Pressure  = Pressure * 100,
    RHO_score = RHO_score * 100,
    .groups = "drop"
  )

pressure_df

dir.create(here("_habitats/HAB_rhodolith_beds/RHO_outputs"), showWarnings = FALSE)
write_csv(
  pressure_df,
  here("_habitats/HAB_rhodolith_beds/RHO_outputs/rho_region_scores_per_year.csv")
)
```

## Current RHO
```{r}
# Select a single year
year_to_show <- 2025   # <-- change this to any year you want

# Filter for selected year
pressure_year <- pressure_df |>
  filter(year == year_to_show) |>
  arrange(region_id)

# Make a kable table
pressure_year |>
  select(region_id, Pressure, RHO_score) |>
  kable(
    digits = 4,
    col.names = c("Region ID", "Pressure", "RHO_score"),
    align = c("c", "r", "r")
  ) |>
  kable_styling(
    bootstrap_options = c("striped", "bordered", "hover"),
    full_width = FALSE
  ) |>
  add_header_above(
    setNames(3, paste0("Rhodolith Pressure & RHO — Year ", year_to_show))
  )
```

```{r}
ohi_rho <- ohi_regions |>
  left_join(
    pressure_year |> transmute(id = as.integer(region_id), RHO_score),
    by = "id"
  )
ohi_land_map   <- ohi_rho |> filter(location == "land")
ohi_marine_map <- ohi_rho |> filter(location == "marine")
ggplot() +
  geom_sf(data = ohi_land_map, fill = "#f5e6c8", color = "gray40", linewidth = 0.3) +
  geom_sf(data = ohi_marine_map, aes(fill = RHO_score), color = "gray20", linewidth = 0.4) +
  scale_fill_distiller(
    palette = "RdYlGn",
    direction = 1,
    name = "RHO score",
    limits = c(0, 100),
    breaks = seq(0, 100, by = 20),
    na.value = "gray90"
  ) +
  labs(title = "Rhodolith habitat status (2025)") +
  theme_void() +
  theme(
    legend.position = "right",
    plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", hjust = 0.5)
  )
```

```{r, fig.width=12, fig.height=7}
# Define region colors
rgn_colors <- c(
  "Region_1" = "#C03729",
  "Region_2" = "#E68C7C",
  "Region_3" = "#FC8F24",
  "Region_4" = "#dcaa38",
  "Region_5" = "#cbd2a0",
  "Region_6" = "#98a25a",
  "Region_7" = "#747428",
  "Region_8" = "#627391",
  "Region_9" = "#8d61a9"
)

# Clean region names in pressure_df to match color names
pressure_df <- pressure_df |>
  mutate(
    region_clean = paste0("Region_", region_id),   # numeric → Region_#
    region_clean = gsub("_", " ", region_clean)    # Region_1 → Region 1
  )

# Clean color names to match cleaned labels ("Region 1", etc.)
rgn_colors_clean <- setNames(
  rgn_colors,
  gsub("_", " ", names(rgn_colors))                # Region_1 → Region 1
)

# RHO time series plot with custom colors
ggplot(
  pressure_df,
  aes(
    x = year,
    y = RHO_score,
    group = region_clean,
    color = region_clean
  )
) +
  geom_point(size = 2) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 1) +
  scale_color_manual(values = rgn_colors_clean) +
  labs(
    title = "RHO Score Over Time",
    x = "Year",
    y = "RHO Score",
    color = "Region ID"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 14)
```

## Format and save data

```{r}
# Calculate condition score (0–100), same pattern as soft bottom
condition_df <- pressure_df |>
  select(region_id, year, condition = RHO_score) |>
  mutate(
    condition = pmin(condition, 100)
  )
condition_df

write_csv(
  condition_df,
  here("_habitats/HAB_rhodolith_beds/RHO_outputs/rho_status.csv")
)

condition_df <- condition_df |>
  mutate(region_id = factor(region_id, levels = 1:9))
ggplot(condition_df, aes(x = year, y = condition)) +
  geom_line(linewidth = 0.8) +
  geom_point(size = 2) +
  facet_wrap(~ region_id, ncol = 3, labeller = labeller(region_id = function(x) paste("Region", x))) +
  scale_x_continuous(breaks = pretty(condition_df$year)) +
  labs(
    x = "Year",
    y = "Condition",
    title = "Condition by region and year"
  ) +
  theme_bw()
```

## Trend Calculation

```{r}
# Trend Calculation: lm for most recent 5 years of data
year_end <- max(condition_df$year, na.rm = TRUE)
year_start <- year_end - 4
calc_trends <- function(d) {
  ys <- min(d$year)
  ye <- max(d$year)
  cs <- d$condition[d$year == ys][1]
  fit_lin <- lm(condition ~ year, data = d)
  fit_log <- lm(log(pmax(condition, 1e-6)) ~ year, data = d)
  slope_lin <- unname(coef(fit_lin)["year"])
  slope_log <- unname(coef(fit_log)["year"])
  tibble(
    year = ye,
    year_start = ys,
    year_end = ye,
    condition_start = cs,
    trend_pct_linear = (slope_lin / cs) * 100,
    trend_pct_cagr   = (exp(slope_log) - 1) * 100
  )
}
trend_df <- condition_df |>
  filter(year >= year_start, year <= year_end) |>
  group_by(region_id) |>
  group_modify(~ calc_trends(.x)) |>
  ungroup()

trend_df

write_csv(
  trend_df,
  here("_habitats/HAB_rhodolith_beds/RHO_outputs/rho_trend.csv")
)
```
